name: ACHLYS
description: Achlys is new: a blacked-out Mark IV-style head in smooth matte black. It has black-on-black cloth, black knobs, grey print and only a faint cold-white light. CHANNEL picks R1, R2 or Lead, like the Mark IV's three channels, and VOICE steps through the captures in that channel (2, 2 and 5).
